```{r}
# Boruta feature selection using the linked amyloid/tau analysis dataset.
# Use the same environment variables as Data_link_Final.Rmd and the speech-marker analyses.
if(!require(Boruta))  install.packages("Boruta")
library(Boruta)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
set.seed(123456)

results_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_RESULTS_DIR", unset = "Results")
data_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = file.path(results_dir, "Data"))
feature_variant <- tolower(Sys.getenv("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT", unset = "normal"))
if (!(feature_variant %in% c("normal", "filtered"))) {
  stop("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT must be 'normal' or 'filtered'.")
}

# Separate output directories keep the two analyses from overwriting one another.
table_dir <- file.path(results_dir, if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "Table_Results_filtered"
} else {
  "Table_Results"
})
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_rds_filename <- if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "tauFeatureAmyloidDemo_filtered.rds"
} else {
  "tauFeatureAmyloidDemo.rds"
}

# The filtered feature table has two additional columns. Keep the same predictor
# boundaries as in the original filtered analysis (7:67; without LMd: 7:66).
# The corresponding normal predictor boundaries are 7:65 and 7:64.
feature_end_col <- if (feature_variant == "filtered") 67 else 65
```

### Load data

```{r}
# Input RDS files are created by the corresponding speech_markers_amyloid notebook.
whole_df<-readRDS(file.path(data_dir, input_rds_filename))
if (ncol(whole_df) < feature_end_col) {
  stop("The input RDS has fewer columns than the selected feature range.")
}
```

```{r}
feat1 <- c("adjectivesRate",
"adverbsRate",
"conjunctionsRate",
"interjectionsRate", 
"noiseRate",
"noiseSentencesRate",
"particlesRate",
"uniqueAdjectivesRate",
"uniqueAdverbsRate",
"uniqueInterjectionsRate",
"uniqueParticlesRate"
)

# type 2: > 0 , right skewed
# model: gamma regression
feat2 <- c(
"pronounProperNounRatio", 
"standardizedPauseRate"
)

# type 3: count variables, with many zeros
# model: negative binomial regression
feat3 <- c(
"betweenUtterancePauseNumber",
"totalFilledPauses",
"totalNoise",
"totalNoiseSentences",
"withinUtterancePause"
)
```

### scale

```{r}
# Keep the original column-based feature selection, adjusted for each variant.
whole_df_amyloid_selected<-whole_df[,c(7:feature_end_col)]
whole_df_amyloid_selected<-na.omit(whole_df_amyloid_selected)
whole_df_tau_selected<-whole_df
whole_df_tau_selected<-na.omit(whole_df_tau_selected)

```


### Amyloid status: Demographics + linguistic features + LMd → amyloid status
```{r}
set.seed(123456)
random_seeds <- sample.int(1e9, 20, replace = FALSE)

results_list <- list()


# Repeat Boruta across 20 random seeds; count how often each feature is confirmed.
for (seed in random_seeds) {
  set.seed(seed)
  boruta_result <- Boruta(ADNI.petpos ~ ., data = whole_df_amyloid_selected, doTrace = 0, maxRuns = 500)
  plot(boruta_result, cex.axis=.7, las=2, xlab="", main="Variable Importance")
  boruta_fixed <- TentativeRoughFix(boruta_result)
  

  stats <- attStats(boruta_fixed)
  stats$feat_name <- rownames(stats)
  

  results_list[[as.character(seed)]] <- stats
}
```



```{r}
# Feature-stability score = number of runs with a "Confirmed" decision.
feature_confirmation_counts <- sapply(results_list, function(x) x$decision == "Confirmed")

feature_stability <- rowSums(feature_confirmation_counts)
feature_stability_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(results_list[[1]]),
  Confirmed_Count = feature_stability
)
```






### Amyloid status: Demographics + linguistic features → amyloid status (without LMd)

```{r}
whole_df_amyloid_selected_nolmd<-whole_df_amyloid_selected[,!colnames(whole_df_amyloid_selected)%in%c('LMd')]
```



### Tau PET: Demographics + linguistic features + LMd + amyloid status → tau
```{r}
set.seed(123456)
random_seeds <- sample.int(1e9, 20, replace = FALSE)

# Analyze each of the six tau PET regions independently.
bi_columns <- c("Amygdala","Putamen","Entorhinal","Inferiorparietal" ,"Inferiortemporal","Precuneus")

boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature <- data.frame(
  Feature = character(),
  count = numeric(),
  tau=character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (tau in bi_columns){
  whole_df_tau_sub<-whole_df_tau_selected %>%
    select(7:feature_end_col, all_of(tau))
  
  results_list_sub <- list()
  for (seed in random_seeds) {
    set.seed(seed)
    formula<-as.formula(paste(tau,'~ .'))
    boruta_result <- Boruta(formula, data = whole_df_tau_sub, doTrace = 0, maxRuns = 500)
    #plot(boruta_result, cex.axis=.7, las=2, xlab="", main="Variable Importance")
    boruta_fixed <- TentativeRoughFix(boruta_result)
    stats <- attStats(boruta_fixed)
    stats$feat_name <- rownames(stats)
    
  
    results_list_sub[[as.character(seed)]] <- stats
  }
  feature_confirmation_counts_sub <- sapply(results_list_sub, function(x) x$decision == "Confirmed")

  feature_stability_sub <- rowSums(feature_confirmation_counts_sub)
  feature_stability_df_sub <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(results_list_sub[[1]]),
    Confirmed_Count = feature_stability_sub
  )
  
  boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature <- rbind(boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature, data.frame(
    Feature = feature_stability_df_sub$Feature,
    count = feature_stability_df_sub$Confirmed_Count,
    tau= tau
    ))
  
}


```



```{r}
boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_wider<-pivot_wider(
  boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature,
  names_from=tau,
  values_from=count
)
  
```



### Tau PET: Demographics + linguistic features + amyloid status → tau (without LMd)

```{r}
whole_df_tau_selected_nolmd<-whole_df_tau_selected[,!colnames(whole_df_tau_selected)%in%c('LMd')]
```


```{r}
set.seed(123456)
random_seeds <- sample.int(1e9, 20, replace = FALSE)

# Analyze each of the six tau PET regions independently.
bi_columns <- c("Amygdala","Putamen","Entorhinal","Inferiorparietal" ,"Inferiortemporal","Precuneus")

boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd <- data.frame(
  Feature = character(),
  count = numeric(),
  tau=character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (tau in bi_columns){
  whole_df_tau_sub<-whole_df_tau_selected_nolmd %>%
    select(7:(feature_end_col - 1), all_of(tau))
  
  results_list_sub <- list()
  for (seed in random_seeds) {
    set.seed(seed)
    formula<-as.formula(paste(tau,'~ .'))
    boruta_result <- Boruta(formula, data = whole_df_tau_sub, doTrace = 0, maxRuns = 500)
    #plot(boruta_result, cex.axis=.7, las=2, xlab="", main="Variable Importance")
    boruta_fixed <- TentativeRoughFix(boruta_result)
    stats <- attStats(boruta_fixed)
    stats$feat_name <- rownames(stats)
    
  
    results_list_sub[[as.character(seed)]] <- stats
  }
  feature_confirmation_counts_sub <- sapply(results_list_sub, function(x) x$decision == "Confirmed")

  feature_stability_sub <- rowSums(feature_confirmation_counts_sub)
  feature_stability_df_sub <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(results_list_sub[[1]]),
    Confirmed_Count = feature_stability_sub
  )
  
  boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd <- rbind(boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd, data.frame(
    Feature = feature_stability_df_sub$Feature,
    count = feature_stability_df_sub$Confirmed_Count,
    tau= tau
    ))
  
}
```

```{r}
boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd_wider<-pivot_wider(
  boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd,
  names_from=tau,
  values_from=count
)
  
```


```{r}
names(boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd_wider) <- c("Feature","Amygdala_nolmd","Putamen_nolmd","Entorhinal_nolmd","Inferiorparietal_nolmd"," Inferiortemporal_nolmd","Precuneus_nolmd" )
```


```{r}
boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_final<-left_join(boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_wider,boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_nolmd_wider,by='Feature')
```

```{r}
write.csv(boruta_tauDemoAmyloidFeature_final,file.path(table_dir, "boruta_tauAmyloidFeatureLMdDemo.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```
